line: A natural-history plate engraves itself: the burin cuts the copper, the bee builds up line by line, and a watercolour wash brings it to life.
line_cn: 一张博物志图版自己刻出来：雕刀推开铜版，蜜蜂一线线成形，最后手工水彩上色。

camera.expresses: The line was part of something larger

camera.move: Push to a part, ride with its roundel
Tilt/pan along the sheet at reading zoom
Locked frame, or a ≤ 2 % breathing push
Cut from mirrored copper to true proof

transitions: Transitions from printmaking only (proof pulled, tissue guard laid over, region burnished out and re-cut, new sheet on the bed);
labels: Lettering belongs to the plate: roman capitals (Bodoni Moda; title ~44–56 px, wide tracking; labels ~15–19 px), italics for scientific names (~20–24 px), script (Pinyon Script) for notes, fixed size, balanced over two lines, never shrunk.
Roman letters are cut glyph by glyph; script is written in one left-to-right stroke. Nothing fades in.

Subtitles: script on a deckled paper slip, bottom centre, ≤ 2 lines, never over a label. Hold ≥ max(1.8 s, speech + 0.6 s). An engraved note stays in frame chars ÷ 12 + 1 s from when it starts writing.
motion: Cutting order is the animation: outline → first hatching sweeping across each form → crossing → darks, hair, stipple. Strokes run at constant burin speed, many at once (a few for outlines, dozens for hatching).
A long single stroke may be followed by the camera; start it partly cut so no frame is empty. Keep a full build to a few seconds.
Roundels fly on an eased arc with a small lift, growing log-linearly to size. Colour blooms from one point with a ragged front and a wet rim that dries; regions staggered.
Nothing fades or slides like UI: lines are cut, text cut or written, colour blooms, sheets are pressed, peeled or laid down.

native_moves.name: The cut
native_moves.does: Burin mid-stroke, swarf rising, nothing else. Fits: the first line of a treaty; a watchmaker's scribe; a coast being charted.

native_moves.name: The three passes
native_moves.does: Form gains volume pass by pass. Fits: a building from its plan; a portrait emerging; a skill improving.

native_moves.name: Magnification roundel
native_moves.does: Ring scribed, burnished, re-cut larger, flown to a margin with a leader, label cut on landing. Fits: a gear in a clock; a pollen grain; a harbour inset on a chart.

native_moves.name: The proof
native_moves.does: Sheet peels off; mirrored copper becomes true paper. Fits: a secret out; a draft made final; a coin's die and strike.

native_moves.name: States of the plate
native_moves.does: A region burnished out and re-cut. Fits: a border redrawn; before/after; a design revision.

native_moves.name: Hand colouring
native_moves.does: Washes bloom after the print. Fits: one organ lit; a flag on a historical map; a ripening fruit.

native_moves.name: Natural size
native_moves.does: A tiny true-scale figure beside the engraving. Fits: a seed by its tree; a chip by its circuit; a stamp by its enlargement.

native_moves.name: The finished plate
native_moves.does: Every label and credit, locked. Fits: a museum label; a frontispiece; a certificate.

score.note: harpsichord, string quartet, solo cello; plucked and dry while lines are cut
